description:
Review uncommitted vault changes, then stage and commit them with git.

Subcommands:
  review [--max-file-lines N] [--max-lines N] — show everything changed since the last commit (read-only)
  save --message SUBJECT [--body TEXT] [--dry-run] — stage every vault change and commit it

Flags:
  review:
    --max-file-lines N   max diff lines per file (default 150)
    --max-lines N   max output lines overall (default 3000)
  save:
    --message SUBJECT   required; one non-empty line
    --body TEXT   optional commit body; may span lines
    --dry-run   report what would be staged and committed; change nothing

Examples:
  ["review"]
  ["save", "--message", "Log SGB hours and payment; close review task", "--body", "Logged 3h DORA validation.\nRecorded payment."]
  ["save", "--message", "Flush buffer", "--dry-run"]

Notes:
  Run review first, then write the summary from its output and pass it to save.
  save only adds a commit. It never amends, rebases, resets, checks out or pushes.
  Exit 1: empty or multi-line --message, vault is not a git repository or not its root, or git failed.
